todos.text: Apply for the DDT RING FINALE 2026 lottery at Korakuen Hall, Sun 27 Dec 11:30, for 8 in one application
todos.detail: The lottery (抽選) is on e+ and is open now; check its closing date on the listing. If it fails, spend that afternoon in Kōenji (already in the plan).
stop_names: DDT RING FINALE 2026 at Korakuen Hall

todos.text: Sign all 8 up for the Grand Santa Parade in Umekita (Tue 22 Dec) the day registration opens
todos.detail: Sign-up details are due in early November on the GRAND FRONT OSAKA and GRAND GREEN OSAKA official sites; check them weekly from Nov 1. The start time and meeting point are not announced yet, so re-time the afternoon once they are. Whether suits are provided is unconfirmed: if not, buy Santa suits at Don Quijote.

todos.text: Book Sushi Kunimitsu's private counter for 8 on Thu 17 Dec, late seating
todos.detail: TableCheck, about ¥22,000 pp. Take the later seating (the shop lists 20:00 on one page and 20:30 on another; your confirmation decides). Write 'private counter for 8' in the requests. A card is required.

todos.text: Book the Harumiya yakatabune shared boat for 8, Sat 26 Dec, 18:00 from Ryōgoku
todos.detail: From ¥13,200 pp with unlimited drinks, 150 minutes, arrive 17:45. Shared boats are cancelled if fewer than 15 guests book: check the booking page a week before. Fallback: Funasei shared yakatabune, shared boats from 2 guests, by phone 03-5479-2731 (10:00–19:00), ¥14,000–16,800 pp.

todos.text: Book teamLab Planets for 8, 10:00 slot on Fri 18 Dec
todos.detail: Tickets are online only. The suitcases go to Kujō House first, so the 10:00 slot is the earliest that works.

todos.text: Phone Uoshin Shibuya for the semi-private room for 8, Wed 16 Dec 18:30
todos.detail: Tabelog online booking or ☎ 03-3464-3000. Same-day cancellations can incur a fee. The course with all-you-can-drink is about ¥6,800 pp.

todos.text: Book Shibuya Sky for 8, sunset slot 15:40 on Wed 16 Dec
todos.detail: Online tickets from the 15:00 slot are ¥3,400 pp; buy online (the counter is dearer). The roof can close in bad weather with no refund after entry.

todos.text: Reserve Romancecar seats for 8, Shinjuku → Hakone-Yumoto, Sat 19 Dec about 10:40
todos.detail: Buy the Hakone Freepass at the Odakyu Sightseeing Service Center (Shinjuku West Exit) that morning.

todos.text: Check whether Pro Wrestling NOAH Thanksgiving 2026 (Fri 18 Dec, Korakuen Hall) is on sale, and buy 8 seats together
todos.detail: Not confirmed on any readable official page. Watch noah.co.jp/schedule and e+ from mid-November. If a foreign card fails, use the Jasumo proxy; some tickets are sold on the day at the 5F counter. Fallback already in the plan: Kabukichō Tower's yokocho hall and Golden Gai.

todos.text: Reserve Shinkansen seats for 8, Odawara → Kyoto, Mon 21 Dec (Kodama/Hikari)
todos.detail: The Tokaido Shinkansen is not covered by the Kansai-Hiroshima Area Pass. smartEX and EX opens one month before.

todos.text: Book Pontochō Robin kamo-nabe (duck hot-pot) for 8, Tue 22 Dec about 19:15
todos.detail: TableCheck. The Santa Parade timing is not fixed yet, so keep the booking flexible.

todos.text: Check the B.LEAGUE fixtures for Sun 27 Dec (Tokyo Sunrockers at Toyota Arena Tokyo; Kawasaki vs Chiba) on bleague.jp
todos.detail: Neither fixture is confirmed on an official page. It is only an alternative to the DDT lottery. Foreign cards often fail on B.LEAGUE ticketing: pick 'pay at convenience store' (コンビニ支払い) or ask the host to buy.

todos.text: Book Matsusakagyu Yakiniku M for 8, Fri 25 Dec 20:00
todos.detail: Online booking; the hall takes groups of up to 30. Open lunch and dinner on Dec 25.

todos.text: Reserve Shinkansen seats for 8: Nozomi Shin-Osaka → Tokyo, Sat 26 Dec about 12:50
todos.detail: smartEX opens Nov 26 10:00 JST. EX Hayatoku 21 is cheaper and sells until Dec 5 (max 6 per booking, so two bookings of 4). Nozomi is all-reserved Dec 25–Jan 5.

todos.text: Buy dated USJ tickets for 8 for Thu 24 Dec and price the Express Pass
todos.detail: USJ's official pages were unreadable to our checker, so confirm the park's Dec 24 hours and the Universal Holiday Wonders details on usj.co.jp. Dynamic pricing: about ¥10,900 pp last year for this date.

todos.text: Book Kingyuen private room for 8 with all-you-can-drink, Tue 15 Dec 18:35
todos.detail: Online booking; private rooms for 6–8. Open every day.

todos.text: Book Chanko Kirishima in Ryōgoku for 8 in a private room, Thu 17 Dec 11:30
todos.detail: Online booking via gorp.jp / Tabelog or ☎ 050-5590-4484. Ask for a 5–10 person private room (個室).

todos.text: Book Genpin Fugu for 8, Mon 21 Dec about 19:00
todos.detail: Hot Pepper. Winter courses with 2 hours of all-you-can-drink and fin sake: the 8-person tour is about ¥9,800 pp. Check its closed day.

todos.text: Buy or reserve the JR Kansai-Hiroshima Area Pass (¥17,000, 5 days) to start Tue 22 Dec
todos.detail: Valid five consecutive days: Dec 22–26. It covers the Sanyo Shinkansen to Hiroshima on Dec 23 including Nozomi and Mizuho (JR West, Jan 2026). Reserve seats together when you exchange it. The cheapest route to Nara is Metro + Kintetsu, not the pass.

todos.text: Email or use the party form to book Gonpachi Nishi-Azabu for 8, Mon 28 Dec 18:00
todos.detail: Online booking (Toreta) only takes 7 or fewer and about a month ahead. Use the party form on gonpachi.jp/nishi-azabu or gonpachi-nishiazabu@global-dining.com, or ☎ +81 50-5443-1691. Seats are 2 hours; one bill; minimum charge ¥1,650 pp after 17:00.

todos.text: Check the hosts can receive forwarded suitcases: Kujō House (Mon 21 Dec) and Garfield House (Sat 26 Dec)
todos.detail: If not, send to a Yamato centre near the house. Also confirm Yamato airport delivery to Haneda T3 on Sun 27 Dec for the Tue 29 Dec flight.

todos.text: Book Albergo Bamboo's upstairs private room for 8: dinner Sat 19 Dec, 17:45
todos.detail: Phone 0460-84-3311 or use the booking form on bamboo.co.jp/albergo; ask for the 2F private room (8名・個室) and the dinner course price. Fallback: Dining Yamaboushi in Sengokuhara (0460-83-8366), which takes banquets for 8. A-Coop is still the villa drinks run (closes 18:00).

todos.text: Phone Arashio-beya the week before to ask whether morning practice on Thu 17 Dec can be watched
todos.detail: Not confirmed: the official page only mentions a membership course. The Grand Sumo winter tour at Hasuda is Wed 16 Dec (sold out; watch e+ resale). Fallback in the plan: the Ryōgoku Kokugikan area and the museums.

todos.text: Reserve the KFC Christmas Party Barrel for pickup on Thu 24 Dec, before the shop closes at 21:00
todos.detail: Reservations typically open in early November, and last year ¥500 off applied if reserved by Dec 12. Online preorder often fails for foreigners: ask the Kujō host to help or reserve in person. Pickup is planned for about 20:00 at the KFC near Kujō.

todos.text: Install the free Round1 app and join the membership
todos.detail: The app takes ¥200–350 off Spo-Cha packs. Round1 asks students and young guests for ID: carry original passports.

todos.text: Set up eSIMs and Welcome Suica on the phones
todos.detail: Ubigi is best for Hakone signal. Welcome Suica Mobile covers Tokyo and Osaka trains.

todos.text: Send the big suitcases to Kujō House with Yamato TA-Q-BIN (Fri 18 Dec morning)
todos.detail: Delivery Mon 21 Dec evening. Take only overnight bags to Hakone.

todos.text: Send the suitcases to Garfield House with Yamato TA-Q-BIN (Fri 25 Dec morning)
todos.detail: Delivery Sat 26 Dec evening.

todos.text: Send the suitcases to Haneda T3 with Yamato airport delivery for the Tue 29 Dec flight
todos.detail: Then check your airline's T3 check-in counter opening time for the 17:20 flight.

coverage.how: Osaka is the base Dec 21–26: Kyoto on Dec 22 (Fushimi Inari, Kiyomizu, Nishiki), Hiroshima and Miyajima on Dec 23, Nara on Dec 25.
Every Osaka night ends in Osaka: Ura-Namba (21), Kyoto night back by the last train (22), Shinsekai and Spa World (23), the house party (24), the Round1 all-nighter (25).
Kyoto nightlife on Dec 22 (Pontochō duck hot-pot, Gion lanterns, Kiyamachi bars) and Hakone nights (snack-bar karaoke, dinner in the castle-style villa Albergo Bamboo).
Drinking every night: Kingyuen and Uoshin all-you-can-drink, yokocho and Golden Gai, fugu with fin sake, Harumiya with unlimited drinks, Ameyoko highballs.
Early starts and late nights with measured travel; Dec 25 and Dec 28 are deliberate all-nighters; arrival evening and departure morning are used.
Round1 Ikebukuro on Dec 15, Round1 Sennichimae until the first train on Christmas night, Round1 DiverCity farewell on Dec 28.
Harajuku streetwear, Kōenji vintage, Ameyoko, Ginza flagships, Amerikamura, Don Quijote, tax-free refund at Haneda.
Sumo, wrestling, onsen, cruise, parades, USJ and shrines are all in; nothing repeats.
No go-karts anywhere.
Hakone Freepass, JR Kansai-Hiroshima Area Pass (cheaper than one Nozomi return), EX Hayatoku 21 for the Dec 26 Nozomi, and booking deadlines in the to-do list.
Each night is built around the four booked stays; luggage forwarding is set in the logistics.
Christmas Day (Dec 25) is in Santa suits from the first stop, ending at Round1 Sennichimae.
The Grand Santa Parade in Umekita is Tue Dec 22; sign-up opens early November and the start time is unconfirmed. Fallback in the plan: Santa suits plus the Umeda Christmas lights.

Pro Wrestling NOAH at Korakuen Hall on Fri Dec 18 is in the plan but unconfirmed; the fallback is Kabukichō Tower and Golden Gai. The DDT year-end show (Dec 27, lottery) is the second wrestling chance.
Not planned: no B.LEAGUE fixture for Dec 26–27 is confirmed on an official page. Sunday Dec 27 is held for the DDT lottery instead; the to-do list says to re-check bleague.jp.
Harumiya yakatabune dinner cruise on Sat Dec 26 under the Odaiba fireworks, with Funasei as the fallback if the shared boat is cancelled.
Hiroshima and Miyajima on Wed Dec 23 with the torii floating at the 09:29 high tide, on the Kansai-Hiroshima pass.

Yunessun's wine, sake and coffee baths on Sun Dec 20 (the sake-pouring show only starts Dec 26). The Hakone night (Sat Dec 19) is dinner in Albergo Bamboo's private room instead of a villa cook-off (the group's call), then the villa's own onsen.
KFC Christmas Party Barrel at Kujō House on Dec 24; pickup is planned for 20:00 because the shop closes at 21:00.
Genpin Fugu in Osaka on Mon Dec 21.
Morning sumo practice at Arashio-beya on Thu Dec 17 is unconfirmed (fallback in the plan); the private omakase counter at Sushi Kunimitsu is that evening.
Spa World on Dec 23 and the Kabukichō Thermae-yu soak on Dec 27, with Manyo Club Toyosu on Dec 18.
Harajuku crawl on Dec 16, Shimokitazawa and Kōenji vintage, Amerikamura, Ameyoko and the Ginza flagships.
Karaoke (Manekineko, Karaokekan), yokocho and Golden Gai nights, Hozenji and Ura-Namba, standing bars.
No nightclubs anywhere in the plan.
Generic page-one stops are cut or reduced; every day has a moment of its own.
Hard-to-book items each carry a named fallback: sumo practice, NOAH, the Santa Parade, the cruise, the KFC barrel and the DDT lottery.
Two deliberate short nights: Dec 25 (all-nighter) and Dec 28 (Round1 farewell).
Every booking is for 8 at one table or private room; the to-do list says how to ask for it.

Plan C is the spine: its surviving places are kept. Dropped or changed: the Unicorn Gundam statue (display ended Aug 31 2026), Meiji Jingū (no time slot that works), and any place whose verified hours clash with its date.

logistics: Luggage, Dec 15–18: everything comes from Haneda to Ninja House (Toshima).

Luggage, Fri 18 Dec: send the big suitcases with Yamato TA-Q-BIN (konbini or front desk) to Kujō House for Mon 21 evening delivery (confirm the host can receive them). Take only overnight bags to Hakone on Dec 19; they ride along to Odawara, Kyoto and Osaka on Dec 21.

Luggage, Fri 25 Dec: send the suitcases from Kujō House to Garfield House (Shinjuku) by TA-Q-BIN for Sat 26 evening delivery (confirm the host can receive them). Dec 26 travel with overnight bags only.
Luggage, Sun 27 Dec: send the big suitcases from Garfield House to Haneda T3 with Yamato airport delivery so Tue 29 Dec is bag-free until the airline bag drop.

Passes: Hakone Freepass (from Shinjuku, Dec 19–20) covers the Odakyu base fare to Hakone-Yumoto, the Tozan trains and buses, ropeway, the pirate ship and discounts at the Open-Air Museum and Glass no Mori. The Romancecar itself needs a separate limited-express ticket (about ¥1,200). The JR Kansai-Hiroshima Area Pass (¥17,000 adult, five consecutive days) should start on Tue 22 Dec (Kyoto by JR) and run to Sat 26 Dec: it covers the Hiroshima day on Dec 23 (Nozomi, Mizuho, Sakura and Hikari are all covered between Shin-Osaka and Hiroshima, per JR West), USJ by JR on Dec 24 and Nara on Dec 25, but not the Tokaido Shinkansen to Tokyo on Dec 26. Dec 21 (Odawara to Kyoto on the Tokaido Shinkansen) is outside the pass.
Transit cards: Welcome Suica on the phone covers Tokyo and, as an IC card, Osaka and Kyoto trains and buses as well. Load enough for a few days so nobody holds up a gate.

Money: pay in yen (decline pay in USD); carry about ¥10,000 cash each for markets, small izakaya, the flea markets and cash-only ramen. Tax-free shopping is a refund system: keep the passports with you at every shop, spend ¥5,000 or more per shop per day, and finish the paperwork at the Haneda T3 customs kiosk before bag drop on Dec 29.
Ages and ID: the drinking age is 20 and some places refuse under-20s (Umi no Ie in Shinjuku, some Round1 night rules). Carry the original passports every night.

Year-end: many shops and attractions shorten or close from Dec 29. The Tokyo Metropolitan Government observatory is closed on both sides on Dec 29 and the north side on Dec 28, so use it on Dec 27 if at all. Odaiba Rainbow Fireworks are on Sat Dec 26 at 19:00 (cancelled in bad weather).

Unconfirmed event items to re-check before spending: Pro Wrestling NOAH Thanksgiving 2026 on Dec 18 (tickets expected mid-November), the Tokyo Sunrockers game on Dec 27 and the Kawasaki–Chiba game (fixtures not on any official page yet), live sumo practice at Arashio-beya on Dec 17 (the winter sumo tour at Hasuda is Dec 16), and the Santa Parade sign-up (opens early November).
